facts.content: xbrain Phase 1 deploys on GCP e2-standard-2 in europe-west1-b
VM static IP is __VM_HOST__, mapped to x.dejavu.cat via Cloudflare
LibreChat lives at https://x.dejavu.cat, Open WebUI at https://ai.dejavu.cat
memory-api admin endpoint is at /memapi/* (not /api/* — collision with LibreChat internal)
Backups go to gs://xbrain-backups-prod/ daily at 02:00 UTC, retention 7 days
VM service account is xbrain-backup-sa with cloud-platform scope (no JSON key — org policy)
Phase 1 stack uses 11 Docker containers, total mem_limit ~3.8 GB
librechat-bridge is a Python sidecar watching Mongo change streams (replSet rs0 required)
openwebui-pipeline is an OpenAI-compatible proxy at port 9099
Tagging contract has 7 mandatory fields enforced via Pydantic v2 extra='forbid'
Truth levels are EPHEMERAL → WORKING → VALIDATED → CANONICAL → PUBLIC
Phase 1 success criterion 5 = restore from backup on clean env passed VALIDATED
Open WebUI v0.9 needs ~750MB peak RSS during HuggingFace embedding model download
Google OAuth Web client refuses raw IPs as redirect URIs — must use real domain or nip.io
Cloudflare SSL mode set to Flexible — Browser↔CF HTTPS, CF↔Origin HTTP
memory-api uses SQLAlchemy 2.0 async with asyncpg driver
Repository pattern enforces team_scope as required signature parameter (no default)
Phase 2 entry gate requires VM upgrade to e2-standard-2 (done) and POC mem0 (this spike)
MemoryProvider interface lives in /packages/memory-models/ for swap-ability
Truth-level promotions require 2 distinct admins for VALIDATED→CANONICAL (4-eyes principle)
Direct PATCH on messages.truth_level returns 405 — workflow obligatoire
LangGraph PostgresSaver checkpointer enables HITL (human-in-the-loop) cross-request resume
Ingestion agent extracts facts via Claude with structured JSON output, 20 facts max per doc
Second-opinion agent calls Claude and Grok in parallel via asyncio.gather
Langfuse self-hosted requires ClickHouse (~2GB RAM) — heavy but free MIT license
Cloudflare proxy enabled (orange cloud) for x.dejavu.cat and ai.dejavu.cat sub-domains
Open WebUI uses sub-domain ai.dejavu.cat, not /openwebui/ sub-path (assets broke)
Docker bridge network xbrain_net hosts all 11 services, only nginx exposes ports 80/443
MongoDB single-node replica set rs0 is required for change streams (LibreChat)
memory-api uvicorn launched via 'python -m uvicorn' (not 'uvicorn' direct — pip --target doesn't add to PATH)
Phase 3 will add Neo4j, Memori, Drive sync, MCP gateway, ~12 requirements
